Out of 100 — Needs Improvement

Shopify foundation is solid (HTTPS, sitemap, product schema, robots.txt), but on-page SEO for collections/pages, local SEO, indexation hygiene, and structured-data quality are holding the store back.

column4: Plain-English meaning
Google can find most pages, but some junk/empty URLs and search pages can still get indexed.
HTTP→HTTPS and non-www→www work. Trailing-slash URLs return 200 (minor duplicate risk, mitigated by canonical).
Sitemap exists and updates. Problem: empty/irrelevant collections are still listed.
Almost all collections & content pages lack meta descriptions. Titles are too short/generic.
Products have schema, but GTINs are duplicated across variants; missing LocalBusiness/Organization.
No About/FAQ/Store page. Blog is empty. 238 collections for ~503 products (many thin/empty).
Phone/email exist, but street address incomplete, no LocalBusiness schema, no Google Business alignment page.
WebP used (good). Many empty alt texts. Viewport blocks pinch-zoom (accessibility/SEO signal).
Server responds fast, but HTML pages are very heavy (~350–500 KB HTML each).
Brand/collection nav is strong; weak supporting content hubs and blog.
